trash_description: Title says HDR, HDR10, HDR10+ (HDR10P), HLG, DV, DoVi or Dolby Vision. Those are 10-bit by definition but rarely say '10bit', so the 10bit format lets them through: 'Resident Evil Welcome to Raccoon City 2021 1080p BluRay DoVi HDR10P x265-GeneMige' was grabbed 2026-11-03 and would not play (2026-11-22). The gpu VM's iGPU cannot decode 10-bit HEVC, so any client that needs a transcode (browser, or a Roku with picture subtitles on) gets a software decode plus HDR tone mapping that the VM cannot do in real time. SDR and HDRip do not match.
name: Homelab: HDR or Dolby Vision
